clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 8854 (Franklin D. Roosevelt, August 16, 1941), held APP transcription, section 1: "Executive Order No. 8168 of June 14, 1939, reserving certain lands near Sitka, Alaska, for use as a magnetic and seismological observatory site by the United States Coast and Geodetic Survey, Department of Commerce, is hereby revoked." The sentence states no later effective date, so the signing date August 16, 1941 is the end date. EO 8854 section 2 re-reserves the same lands for the same agency, which continues the use under the later order and does not keep EO 8168 in force.

research_rationale:
EO 8168 (June 14, 1939, Franklin D. Roosevelt), read in full in the held Federal Register text (printed number 8168), transfers lands at Sitka, Alaska, from the Department of Agriculture to the Department of Commerce. Its operative words revoke the Executive order of August 12, 1898 and reserve the lands that order described for the Coast and Geodetic Survey as a magnetic and seismological observatory site. It states no term or condition. EO 8854 (August 16, 1941), held only as an American Presidency Project transcription (Common Crawl capture 2025-09-07; a provisional working text), revokes EO 8168 by number in its section 1 and, in its section 2, withdraws and reserves the same lands and an adjoining tract for the same agency and purpose. The first end of EO 8168 is that express revocation.

savings.reason: The reservation for the Coast and Geodetic Survey did not lapse when EO 8168 was revoked: EO 8854 section 2 withdraws and reserves "lands contained in the reservation made by the said Executive Order No. 8168" and an adjoining tract for the same agency and the same observatory purpose, so the lands stayed reserved by the later order. The earlier command to revoke the 1898 Executive order was performed when EO 8168 was signed on June 14, 1939; its effect (the release of those lands from the Department of Agriculture's use) is a surviving consequence, and no held source shows that EO 8854 undid it.
